description: Return one XPass conductor verdict for a target PR/change at a specific commit SHA. Selected PASS receipts must name the same head SHA; stale, unscoped, missing, or blocker receipts cannot produce a green verdict.

available_checks.description: Optional worker availability list. Selected checks outside this list are NOT RUN and cannot make the verdict green.

body.description: Optional body text used for check selection.

changed_files.description: Changed file paths for check selection.

context.description: Optional extra context used for check selection.

description.description: Optional PR/change description used for check selection.

enabled_checks.description: Optional suite restriction. When supplied, XPass only gates the selected checks that are enabled here.

generated_at.description: Optional deterministic timestamp for tests or replay.

owned_files.description: Owned file paths for check selection.

pass_results.description: Underlying Pass receipts or summarized results. Green results must include target_sha/head_sha matching target.sha.

require_council.description: Force the Crews Council recommendation on this XPass receipt.

results.description: Map form of pass_results keyed by check name.

selected_checks.description: Optional explicit XPass product checks to require for this verdict.

summary.description: Optional summary text used for check selection.

tags.description: Optional tags used for check selection.

target.description: Target change to inspect. target.sha or target.head_sha is required for anti-stale proof binding.

description.description: Optional target summary used for check selection.

files.description: Changed file paths for check selection.

id.description: PR number, issue id, branch label, or artifact id.

pr_number.description: PR number when the target is a pull request.

ref.description: Optional branch, PR, or artifact ref.

title.description: Optional target title used for check selection.

type.description: Target type, such as pr, branch, commit, url, artifact, or change.

title.description: Optional PR/change title used for check selection.

name: xpass_aggregated_verdict
